proposal.rationale: Perform pseudobulk aggregation at the sample level using DESeq2 to identify differentially expressed genes between fake_B and fake_A in Mono C cells, adjusting for technical batch (pool) and biological covariates (sex and age).
expected_limitations: Large number of levels in the pool covariate may consume degrees of freedom depending on the total sample size.
Potential low count aggregation in samples with low cell yield for Mono C.
